description: Lieux de stationnement (organisation Commune de BONS-EN-CHABLAIS) is a dataset listed in Open platform of French public data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Commune de BONS-EN-CHABLAIS. State of play of the parking and carpooling offer throughout the municipal territory of Bons-en-Chablais. Reference year: 2026. This includes all public and private car parks (provided) on and off the road. Coverage: Commune de BONS-EN-CHABLAIS. The portal shows the English title as "Parking places (organisation Commune de BONS-EN-CHABLAIS)" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Commune de BONS-EN-CHABLAIS. Its keywords include lieux-de-covoiturage, covoiturage, stationnement, parking. The listing shows 1 download or service links in CSV. The listing shows 2026-07-15 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://www.etalab.gouv.fr/licence-ouverte-open-licence). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-plateforme-ouverte-des-donnees-publiques-francaises.
